user.title: Connect to the Mira agent
user.description: Address and API token of the Mira agent (server.listen and server.token in its config).

zeroconf_confirm.title: Mira found
zeroconf_confirm.description: A Mira agent announced itself at {url}. Enter its API token (server.token).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the agent at this address.

abort.no_id: The agent did not announce an id; update it.

data_description.timeout: After this the satellite says a short error instead of staying silent.

add_notice.name: Add notice
add_notice.description: Queue a notice. The agent announces it on a satellite when someone is in a room, or sends it privately.

text.name: Text
text.description: What to say, one or two spoken sentences.

details.name: Details
details.description: The long form, for follow-up questions.

importance.name: Importance
importance.description: 0 not worth mentioning, 1 by the way, 2 important today, 3 urgent.

audience.name: Audience
audience.description: household, or a person id from the agent config.

confidentiality.name: Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: Confidential notices are only spoken when the agent policy allows it, otherwise sent privately.

dedupe_key.name: Dedupe key
dedupe_key.description: An open notice with the same key is updated instead of duplicated.

expires_in.name: Expires in
expires_in.description: Duration like 12h; afterwards the notice is dropped. Default 24h.

task.name: Task
task.description: The automation's id ({{ this.attributes.id }}): the notice shows in the task's log.

assess.name: Assess
assess.description: Mira judges what happened against the goal, with the data she looks up and condenses; if it is worth it, she words a notice and delivers it like any other. Answers importance, spoken and notice_id.

goal.name: Goal
goal.description: What this task is for, in the user's words.

data.name: Data
data.description: List of {entity_id, view}; view state, same_hour (last hour against the same hour on 14 days) or day (today so far against the same weekdays).

memory.name: Memory
memory.description: relevant: profile and matching facts; profile; none.

cooldown.name: Cooldown
cooldown.description: Like 6h: within it the task only reports again when it gets more important.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Off: only the verdict, no notice (dry run).

audience.name: Audience
audience.description: household, or a person id from the agent config.

confidentiality.name: Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: Confidential notices are only spoken when the agent policy allows it.

dedupe_key.name: Dedupe key
dedupe_key.description: An open notice with the same key is updated instead of duplicated.

task.name: Task
task.description: The automation's id ({{ this.attributes.id }}): its judgements share a log and earlier verdicts.

decide.name: Decide
decide.description: Mira answers a yes/no question with the data she looks up; no notice. Use with response_variable and a template condition.

data.name: Data
data.description: List of {entity_id, view}, as for Assess.

data_description.entity: Home or away decides where notices go.
data_description.telegram_user_id: Numeric; must be on the agent's Telegram allowlist.

data_description.morning: The first motion after quiet hours announces what is pending.
data_description.mode: Announce speaks notices when someone comes in; indicate only lights the indicator, and you ask "Do you have a notification?". Urgent notices and reminders are always spoken.
data_description.indicator: Shows waiting notices, e.g. the LED ring of the satellite.
